projects.title: Vocal Quest - AI-Driven Accessible Gaming
projects.bodyText:
- University capstone project focused on **accessible gaming using voice commands and Natural Language Understanding**.
 - Worked on the **frontend, backend and UI/UX design** using React, Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB.
 - Implemented authentication, application routes and accessibility features for users with visual and motor disabilities.
 - Used **Web Speech API, Text-to-Speech and Web Audio** technologies.

projects.title: Explore Ceylon
projects.bodyText:
- An ongoing hiking information website focused on **mountains and hiking destinations in Sri Lanka**.
 - Provides information about hiking routes, maps, videos, preparation and accommodation.
 - Built as a personal project to improve my **frontend development and web design skills**.

projects.title: The Golden Plate
projects.bodyText:
- A Sri Lankan restaurant website designed to present local food and the restaurant experience.
 - Built the website using **HTML and CSS** with a focus on clean presentation and responsive design.
